we proposed a modular teleoperation platform based on the ROS which is flexible and easy to use.

we propose a modular teleoperation system based on the robot operation system (ROS), and a hybrid workspace mapping strategy for asymmetric master slave teleoperation systems is also proposed, which is verified by the comparative experiments.
we propose a modular teleoperation platform based on the ROS and develop a novel workspace mapping algorithm to cover the whole slave workspace and simultaneously achieve an elaborate manipulation.

the modular development of master slave teleoperation systems, which is flexible and convenient for different master and/or slave devices, especially for the asymmetric master slave teleoperation.
the design and development of modular teleoperation systems with a novel workspace mapping algorithm.
the design of modular teleoperation systems and the development of a novel workspace mapping algorithm for asymmetric master slave teleoperation.

the modular teleoperation system proposed in this paper has a good performance and is flexible and portable to different master and slave systems.

the proposed modular development method and the hybrid workspace mapping algorithm can facilitate the design, implementation, and adjustment of teleoperation systems with a great flexibility, portability, and high mapping accuracy.

a modular teleoperation system can be developed easily and quickly, which is suitable for different master and/or slave devices and can be adjusted and optimized in MATLAB/Simuliink.
